title: Graphic Designer Intern
description:
**Job description:**

**About Us:**

Hawmartech is a next-gen, performance-driven marketing and technology group built to scale brands through data, creative, and media innovation. From cutting-edge UI/UX and custom digital solutions to full-scale SaaS product development, we power digital transformation through integrated product engineering and marketing expertise. As a unified force, we drive innovation and growth for both challenger brands and enterprise clients. We’re looking for a creative and detail-oriented Graphic Design Intern to join our team and help bring our brand to life through compelling visual content.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Assist in designing digital and print materials including social media graphics, presentations, email campaigns, infographics, and more
* Support the creation and development of brand assets across various platforms
* Collaborate with marketing, content, and product teams to understand design requirements and deliver high-quality visuals
* Participate in brainstorming sessions and contribute creative ideas
* Receive feedback from team members and make necessary revisions
* Maintain organized project files and meet deadlines

**Requirements:**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or a related field
* Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and/or other relevant design tools (e.g., Figma, Canva)
* Strong eye for design, layout, color, and typography
* Basic understanding of branding and design principles
* Excellent attention to detail and time management
* Good communication and teamwork skills

Job Types: Full-time, Internship

Contract length: 6 months

Benefits:

* Food provided

Work Location: In person

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹15,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided

Work Location: In person

title: WEB Designer
description:
Company Details:

Founded in 1999, Wizie.com is a trusted name in Travel Technology, delivering cutting-edge solutions such as Booking Engines, GDS Connectivity, PNR Management, and Automation tools.

We work with Airlines, OTAs, Travel Agencies, and Loyalty Programs worldwide, powering their digital transformation journeys.

We’re now expanding our B2C and B2B marketing initiatives for Australia-based tour packages and local travel experiences and are looking for a PPC-first Digital Marketer to scale these efforts.

**JOB DETAILS:**

**Position:** WEB Developer

**Working days:** 5 days working (work from office only)

**Office Timings :** 12:30-9:30PM

**Essential Skills :**

* Scripting Language: HTML5, CSS3/SCSS/SASS, JavaScript, jQuery, Bootstrap, CMS.
* **Software’s: Adobe Dreamweaver , Photoshop, XD, Figma**
* Exposure to Search Engine Optimization (SEO) will be preferred.
* Work experience in travel domain would be an added advantage.

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* Do you have Experience in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Figma, and Photoshop?
* What is your current CTC?

Experience:

* Web design: 2 years (Required)

Work Location: In person
